description:
Filed and fixed by s527b (2026-10-25), member M1.  docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md §55, registry row §55, report rows (21) in docs/ppi-bug-report.t + the branch's t/ppi_bugs_pcl.t.

perl 5.40.3:  package O; sub w {10} package main; my $o = bless {}, "O"; sub w {2} my %h = (a => 5); my $i = 5; print $o->w*w(), " ", $i++*w(), " ", $h{a}%-1, "\n";   ->  20 10 0
PPI 1.291 lexes *w as a glob after a method name and after $i++, and %- as the magic hash after a subscript's }.  Same family: $i++ / 2 starts a match; $i++.2, $o->name.2 are a Float; $o->w-1 a negative Number; @{$h}*$x, ${$x}%$y a Cast; /a/*f(), <<E.2 (a match / substitution / transliteration / here-doc was missing from the term table).

On main (vendored PPI at 8955ba30) `print "10 ", @{$h}*$y`, `print ${$sx}%$y` and `print $i++ / 2` were DROPPED ("Bug. Fell through"); PCL's _ends_term covers the other shapes through the seven s527a-kept repairs.

Fix (branch pcl, group J: e29c38cc tests, d8bcdfa1 fix): Tokenizer::_ends_term_at (method Word after ->, postfix ++/--, } by _curly_kind: subscript / deref / do-eval value block), used by _opcontext, Token::Unknown's % and * arms and _cast_or_op, Token::Operator's .digit test, Token::Whitespace's / arm.  Side effect: §33 fixed (the old } back-scan stopped at the first ; inside the block).  Group K (0a536af5): a { that opens the document is a block (§38's report rows 90/91).


=== DONE (s527b) ===
Fixed at the source: groups J (e29c38cc tests / d8bcdfa1 fix: Tokenizer::_ends_term_at + _curly_kind, used by _opcontext, Unknown's % * and _cast_or_op, Operator's .digit, Whitespace's /) and K (0a536af5, a { opening the document is a block); df9e06cb/487563de (a builtin that takes no operand ends a term); vendored, now part of pcl 6a5de5c1.  The 21 §55 report rows pass on the vendored lib.  PCL repairs that the rule made inert were deleted one per commit (corpus-diff IDENTICAL each): §4 _fix_modulo_magic, §12 _repair_glob_multiply, §25 _repair_minus_word, §28 _repair_dot_number + _is_print_filehandle_slot, §38 _repair_statement_start_glob_cast; §15/§34 and §21 narrowed to what only PCL's prototype table knows.  Side fix: lib/Hash/Util.pm:299 `%{ $s->{d} } = ();` after a for block, DROPPED on main, compiles (guard hash-util-shim-01.t block 5).  Records: docs/ppi-fix-at-source-s527.md §8 "s527b: done", DECIDED ## s527b.
